Physical Science · Year 1

Discover magnets through everyday examples, hands-on investigations and playful challenges. Explore magnet shapes, attraction and repulsion, and compare magnet strength.

🧲 7.0 Magnet🔍 Observe & Investigate🎯 Design with Magnets

🌟 Start Your Science Adventure

Big Idea (Understanding)

Magnets have different shapes and uses. By testing objects and magnet poles, pupils can observe attraction, repulsion or no reaction, compare magnet strength and communicate their findings.

🧠 KNOW & DO

📘 KNOW — Facts & Understanding

Examples of everyday uses of magnets; common magnet shapes; attraction, repulsion and no reaction; north and south poles; and ways to compare magnet strength through investigation.

🧪 DO — Learning in Action

Identify magnet types and uses, test different objects, investigate how poles interact, compare magnets fairly, explain observations and design a simple magnetic game or tool.
